notes:
## Changes
- **Smoother scrolling:** as you scroll through scenes or folders, the pictures for the next rows load ahead of time, so tiles appear with their picture instead of blank.
- **Sharper Dashboard charts:** every chart on the Dashboard is now drawn the same way as "Tags by year", with crisp labels in the app's font and the same tooltips showing the name, the figure and its share of the total.

## Fixes
- The Dashboard charts' axis labels were softer than the rest of the app; they're now as sharp as everything else.
linuxNotes:
First Linux preview of Video Shelf: the whole app on Ubuntu and similar systems (.deb). It uses the same catalogue as the Windows app.

Install with:

    sudo apt install ./videoshelf_0.12.0_amd64.deb
